_readme: Copy to customer.config.json (git-ignored) to brand the lab. Only these three cast values are read; everything else is ignored. engineer is the first person's account name (lowercase letters, digits, dots and dashes, and not the name of anyone else in the pack); host is one label and becomes <host>.example. Overrides the chosen vertical's values. The people, agents, repositories and roles in the stories are synthetic and are not otherwise configurable.
